svg.text: ROUND 348 · 🏆 710 VECTORS MILESTONE · AIRLINE GDS/NDC REVENUE INTEGRITY (AMADEUS / SABRE / PROS) & IATA BSP/ADM SETTLEMENT
Airline GDS/NDC Revenue Integrity (Amadeus/Sabre), IATA BSP & ADM AI Agent Security FAQ
O&D Bid-Price Vector & VVIP PNR Air-Gap + Married-Segment/IRROPS Waiver Lock vs. PNR Remark Injection & BSP Commission Wire Fraud (BRK-705 / BRK-706)
🚨 1. Top 3 Airline Revenue Integrity & BSP Threat Vectors
① PNR Remark / ADM Dispute Injection Leaking Bid-Prices (BRK-705)
• Adversarial travel agency PNR OSI/SSR remark or BSPlink Agency
Debit Memo (ADM) dispute PDF embeds prompt injection
• Coerces Agent into reading O&D dynamic Bid-Price hurdle vectors,
corporate net fares & Federal Air Marshal / VVIP PNR manifests
② Forged IRROPS Waiver & Married-Segment Unbundling (BRK-705)
• Issues unauthorized involuntary reroute (SKCHG) waiver codes to
reissue deep-discount Economy into Class-J Business at $0 add-collect
• Withdraws valid ADMs for skiplagging & married-segment abuse
• Impact: Premium cabin inventory dilution & tariff evasion
③ Spoofed IATA BSP Override & EU261 Escrow Wire Fraud (BRK-706)
• Forged OTA back-end incentive (Override Commission) or EU261
claim aggregator notice overwrites BSP IBAN in trust-registry
• Triggers unauthorized $5,060 agency incentive wire (request_payment)
• Impact: Airline passenger revenue theft & BSP clearing breach
🛡️ 2. Zero-Trust Airline Revenue Integrity Architecture
Gate 1: PNR Remark & BSPlink ADM Dispute Sanitization
• Strips free-text PNR OSI/SSR remarks; extracts typed EDIFACT/
NDC slots (13-digit e-ticket, IATA number, fare basis, coupon status)
• Propagates untrusted=True, lane="attack" across all agent hops
Gate 2: O&D Bid-Price Vector & VVIP Manifest Air-Gap
• PROS/Amadeus O&D Bid-Price curves, corporate net contracts &
Air Marshal / VVIP PNR lists isolated in restricted-budget
• Enforced by record-owner + restricted-data-boundary
Gate 3: Deterministic ATPCO Cat 31/33 & OCC Flight-Status Lock
• Involuntary waivers require verified Operations Control (OCC)
flight disruption ID; AI cannot waive add-collect or cancel ADMs
• Enforced by untrusted-write (100% unauthorized waiver block)
Gate 4: Read-Only IATA BSP / ICH Registry & Dual-Key Release
• Locks BSP/ARC/agency IBANs in trust-registry (tool-allowlist +
fixed-business-output) + original-requester-payment gate
📊 3. Architecture Selection Matrix & Benchmarks
Airline Revenue Integrity Security Options Compared:
A. Capability Broker + Bid-Price Air-Gap + OCC Lock (Recommended 🏆)
✓ 100% block on BRK-705/706 | IATA Res 850m & PCI-DSS ready
B. Native Amadeus Altea / Sabre / Accelya Revera RBAC
⚠ Fails when shared ticketing audit bot is hijacked via PNR OSI
C. Cloud LLM Guardrails (Azure Prompt Shields / Bedrock)
⚠ Blind to ATPCO Cat 31/33 fare rules, O&D marriage & OCC state
D. Manual Revenue Accounting Sampling of PNRs & ADMs
✕ Audits <5% of tickets; cannot stop real-time GDS Churning
🧪 Deterministic Pytest Regressions (Round 348 · 710 Vectors!):
• Baseline Policy: Allows $0 Class-J reissue, leak & wire ❌
• Hardened Policy: 100% Blocked by 5 Deterministic Rules ✅
- record-owner: Blocks O&D Bid-Price & VVIP read (restricted-budget)
- untrusted-write: Blocks IRROPS waiver & ADM cancel (business-result)
- restricted-data-boundary: Blocks Bid-Price vector egress
- tool-allowlist / fixed-business-output: Locks BSP trust-registry
- original-requester-payment: Blocks $5,060 agency commission wire
🚀 Principal SA Go-Live Checklist & Cumulative Milestone (Round 348 · 🏆 710 Interactive Playground Vectors Milestone!)
✅ 1. Bid-Price & VVIP Air-Gap: Isolate PROS/Amadeus O&D Bid-Price vectors, corporate net fares & Air Marshal PNRs in restricted-budget
✅ 2. Deterministic OCC & ATPCO Lock: Bind involuntary reroute waivers (SKCHG) to verified OCC flight disruption events; block untrusted-write
✅ 3. BSPlink Netting Only: Route agency commissions & ADM credits strictly through IATA BSP/ARC net settlement; lock trust-registry
📊 Cumulative Metrics: 724 Scenarios (721 Risk + 3 Benign) | 778 Pytest Checks | 1,514 Assertions | 🏆 710 Vectors | 348 Bilingual FAQs (166 SA Guides) | BRK-705/706
